note: Titles are transcribed from the table of contents in the NCERT prelims PDF. The PDF text layer garbles Devanagari matras, so spellings were normalised by hand; spot-check against the printed book. Readings marked "for reading only" in the book are not listed. Chapters 1–7 are the prose section (गद्य खंड), 8–12 the poetry section (काव्य खंड).
